line: Bitcoin drifting higher on modest leverage and neutral technicals, with regulatory tightening in Switzerland, France, and Kazakhstan the day's dominant thread.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin +1.15% on the day, spot ETF net -10.3M USD (Oct 20, 2026), Fear & Greed 55 (neutral), funding +0.0065% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: Swiss regulator FINMA approved the country's first retail bitcoin ETF holding bitcoin directly, with custody safeguards and volatility warnings required.
France's National Assembly voted 38-37 to impose 31% capital-gains tax on stablecoin conversions starting January 2027, removing tax deferral.
Kazakhstan court banned Coinbase, BingX, OKX, Bybit, Huobi, and Gate.io from unlicensed crypto services in the Astana International Financial Centre.
